'''Dekluun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who led [[Troop/Legends|troops]] when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]] was [[Battle of Thustra|invaded]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] after the Sephi had seceded from the Republic in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. While deploying his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] to prepare for an attack on the Republic [[unit]]s, Dekluun was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the enemy launched a surprise strike.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Commander Dekluun! Something's coming!''"<br />"''&hellip; No!|A soldier and Dekluun, seconds before their deaths|<ref name="JediYoda" />}}
Dekluun was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="JediYoda" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> the Sephi under their [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]] decided to secede from the Republic and join the Confederacy, an action that resulted in a Republic task force being sent to Thustra in order to make a show of force. Holding the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]], Dekluun led [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in the [[Battle of Thustra|ensuing battle]], in which the first attacks by the Sephi inflicted heavy casualties on the Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="JediYoda" />

Dekluun than began to deploy his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] just out of range of the Republic forces, preparing to attack the enemy and drive them from Thustra. However, the Sephi [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], [[Navi]], betrayed both his own people and the Republic in a power gamble and gave the Republic forces the coordinates of the Dekluun's forces as well as the location of a hidden pass that could be used to surprise the Sephi. While still preparing the troops for his own attack, Dekluun and his [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were caught off-guard by the Republic. [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] opened [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on the Sephi positions, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Dekluun in the first [[Standard second|seconds]] of the assault.<ref name="JediYoda" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We know every rock and blade of grass out here&mdash;&mdash;every hiding sport and attack point. We're fighting for our land and for our families. They're the ones at a disadvantage, Sir.''"<br />"''Hold onto that&mdash;&mdash;|The aide and Dekluun|<ref name="JediYoda" />}}
Dekluun was an able military commander and realized that for a victory over the superior weapons and numbers of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army he would have to employ every possible advantage. Despite this, the attack of the Republic forces caught him completely by surprise and led to his death. When [[Dekluun's aide|his aide]] pointed out that the Sephi were the ones with an advantage as they fought to protect their families and their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], he was happy about his subordinate's attitude. Dekluun had [[Color/Legends|white]] hair, black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and pink skin.<ref name="JediYoda" />

==Armor and equipment==
During the battle of Thustra, the commander wore whole-body [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="JediYoda" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dekluun first appeared in the ''[[Jedi: Yoda]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Jeremy Barlow]] and illustrated by [[HOON]]. ''Jedi: Yoda'' was released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] and published in [[2004]]. The commander later received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' ([[2008]]).
